Metric definitions (short): DAU/MAU = unique logged‑in user_id per UTC day/month; New users = first verified signup timestamp; Primary feature adoption = unique users with event feature_used where feature_id='primary_feature' (fallback: action_performed → map when action_type indicates primary feature); Activation = activation_event (activation_complete) within 7 days of signup; 7‑day retention = percent of signup cohort active on day 7.
